summary.intent: Determine whether phase 73 (CipherBox shared-write/navigation correctness) had open discussion points before planning, then kick off /gsd-plan-phase 73 on the correct feature branch while folding in tangential pending todos discovered during scoping.
summary.outcome: Confirmed phase 73 had no blocking discussion artifacts, folded 2 of 51 pending todos into the ROADMAP as new success criteria, created and committed work on the correct branch (feat/shared-write-navigation-correctness-web) instead of the planner's default docs/plan-phase-73, and ran research + pattern-mapping + planning stages to produce 9 committed PLAN.md files across 3 waves (plan-checker verification not yet run).

repo: GSD phase branch naming follows phase_branch_template 'feat/{slug}' where slug is the phase directory name minus the number prefix (e.g. phase 73 dir 'shared-write-navigation-correctness-web' -> branch 'feat/shared-write-navigation-correctness-web'), matching precedent from phase 72.

gsd-core plan-phase workflow Step 0 explicitly forbids creating/renaming/switching git branches during plan-phase execution — the planner will stay on whatever branch is checked out, so pre-creating the correct feat/ branch before invoking /gsd-plan-phase prevents the stray docs/plan-phase-{N} branch issue.

plan:pre hooks in this repo: intel, research, pattern-mapper, schema-gate->planner, tdd->planner, drift-gate. schema-gate only fires when a phase touches TypeORM entity/migration files — it did not fire for phase 73 since SC4 only surfaces an already-emitted SDK-layer tombstone.
gsd-planner does not auto-commit PATTERNS.md produced by gsd-pattern-mapper — must be committed explicitly as a separate step.
intel's regenerated API-SURFACE.md can come back empty (0 symbols, HINT-only) for a phase; real grounding for planning in that case comes from RESEARCH.md and PATTERNS.md instead.

code.finding: Never calls runWithFailureUx — a real API 410 (tombstone) currently surfaces as an uncaught AxiosError instead of the classifier-driven refreshWriteAccess flow that SC4 requires.
Validation Architecture section present, triggering VALIDATION.md generation from template per plan-phase §5.5.

workflow: When scanning a large pending-todo backlog (51 items) for relevance to a phase's scope, delegate the classification to a subagent rather than reading each todo directly — preserves context budget.

Before committing to a multi-agent planning pipeline, use AskUserQuestion to lock ambiguous decisions (e.g., SC4's 'wire end-to-end vs trim' fork, and research-first vs skip-research) into CONTEXT.md so downstream researcher/planner agents inherit them consistently.
Sanity-check ROADMAP.md diffs after the planner runs for truncation (line count, all phase headers intact) before committing — known gsd-planner risk from prior sessions.
Sequencing constraint from research determines plan wave ordering: SC7 -> SC6 -> SC1+SC2 -> SC4, driven by which fixes unblock which (e.g., fetchShareKeys must survive before dead-path removal).

friction: Phase 73 had no directory yet, requiring manual creation before any planning artifacts could be written.

Had to proactively work around the known gsd-planner behavior of sometimes spinning up a stray 'docs/plan-phase-73' branch instead of the correct feat/ branch, by pre-creating and committing to the right branch first.
PATTERNS.md required a manual explicit commit since plan-phase does not auto-commit it — an easy step to miss.

SC4's actual scope was materially deeper than the source todo (WRITE-03) implied — research revealed useSharedWriteOps.ts has no runWithFailureUx call at all, changing the plan from 'wire an existing path' to building missing error-handling plumbing.
open_items: SC4 (refreshWriteAccess / CannotWriteUntilRefetchError) 'wire end-to-end' approach was locked in, but it overlaps STATE's still-open Q1 (Phase 68) — co-writer offline during write-key rotation (explicit re-fetch vs grace/notification) — not fully resolved, just deferred to phase 73 execution.

Three adjacent-but-separate pending todos (SDK merge parity, dead SDK scaffolding retirement, ESLint boundary rule) were deliberately excluded from phase 73 scope and left pending — candidates for a future phase.
gsd-plan-checker verification loop (task 5 in the tracked pipeline) had not yet been run by end of transcript — 9 PLAN.md files are committed but not yet checker-validated.
